name: Worldwide Governance Indicators

measures.definition: Control of corruption: how far public power is exercised for private gain, petty and grand, and captured by elites and private interests, as perceived by households, firms and experts; an estimate of roughly -2.5 (weak) to 2.5 (strong).

rights.edition: Worldwide Governance Indicators, GOV_WGI_CC.EST (License_Type CC BY-4.0 in its metadata)
rights.attribution: World Bank, Worldwide Governance Indicators, Control of Corruption estimate, CC BY 4.0

vetted.notes: Licence read on the World Bank Data Catalog page for the dataset (Creative Commons Attribution 4.0) on 2026-11-05.

caveats: A perception measure built from 35 surveys and expert assessments, with a margin of error: small differences between countries mean little.
A country figure standing in for the city.
